<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/api/catalog_library/{local_name}/{name}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Removes a library version - or the whole library - from a catalog
published from this grid.

Refused when one of the catalog's own node templates pins what is being
removed, since that would leave a template no subscriber could build a
node from. Remove the template first, or remove a different version.
